newsitem.title: SWEDEN: S&P gives Nordbanken Hypotek K-1 rating.
newsitem.headline: S&P gives Nordbanken Hypotek K-1 rating.

text.p: U.S. rating agency Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday it had given Nordbanken Hypotek, the mortgage lending subsidary of Swedish banking group Nordbanken, the rating K-1 for its Swedish commercial paper.
The K-1 rating was given to the 20 billion commercial paper program of Nordbanken Hypotek.

"Nordbanken Hypotek's rating is based on its strategic importance as a core business of the Nordbanken group and the increasing strong operational integration with its parent," S&P's said in a statement.
Nordbanken Kredit and Nordbanken Hypotek merged in November 1996. S&P said the sustained robust capitalization of the two constituent companies and strong asset quality supported the rating.

Nordbanken Hypotek's capitalization was very robust due to the composition of risk assets, the majority of which require 50 percent or less coverage, as well as to sound earnings retentions, S&P said. It added capital levels of the company support asset growth comfortably.
"Asset quality of the integrated company is strong due to the high level of residential mortages, accounting for 45 percent of the loan portfolio, which are considered low risk," S&P said.
S&P also pointed out Nordbanken Hypotek's exposure to the weaker retail and commercial property sector has been reduced to less than five percent of the loan portfolio.
